links.title:
RIPEMD-160 (RACE Integrity Primitives Evaluation Message
Digest)

text:
rmd160
Description
Returns the
RIPEMD-160 (RACE Integrity Primitives Evaluation Message
Digest)
message digest of the
specified string, or an empty string if an error occurs. Used to
ensure data integrity.
Syntax
rmd160
<
string
>
rmd160 <string>
Returns the RIPEMD-160 message digest of the specified string, or an
empty string if an error occurs.
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
binary
scan
[
rmd160
[
HTTP
::
host
]]
w1
key
set
key
[expr
{
$key
&
1
}]
switch
$key
{
0
{
pool
my_pool
member
1.2
.3.4:80
}
1
{
pool
my_pool
member
5.6
.7.8:80
}
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ALL_EVENTS
,
GLOBAL_GTM
